summary.text: An SEO platform tested by SelectVerdict through its official Data API and Project API for keyword research, live SERP analysis, rank tracking, domain research, and backlink research.

keyFeatures.text: Keyword research returned data for 23 of 25 frozen keywords and explicit no-data for two.
All six frozen SERP deep-dives returned ten results.
Rank Tracker returned position rows for 24 of 25 configured keywords during the verification window.

pros.text: Completed all six fixed SERP deep-dives in the observed API run.
Returned immediate rank rows for 24 of 25 frozen keywords.

cons.text: The browser access path was blocked by human verification in this test environment.
The API run encountered rate limiting and required throttling and retries.

bestFor.text: Teams that need the broader set of modules observed in this test and can work within their plan or API limits.

notFor.text: Buyers who need this report to prove a specific plan price or browser workflow; those were not established by the captured evidence.

sources.title: SelectVerdict Phase 1A SE Ranking hands-on results
sources.supports: Frozen test inputs, returned outputs, limitations, workflow, cost, and verification gate.

verdict.summary: The observed API run produced complete fixed-SERP coverage and near-complete immediate rank output.
verdict.basis: A frozen 25-keyword, six-SERP, four-domain hands-on run completed on 2026-09-21.
